# The AI Disciple

> AI consulting and training for small businesses, churches and nonprofits, run by Aaron Tenney
> from Fresno, California. The practice finds the three to five tasks in an organization's week
> that AI can reliably take over, builds those workflows properly, and trains the team to run
> them without a consultant on speed dial.

**Website:** https://www.theaidisciple.com
**Contact:** aaron@theaidisciple.com · (559) 718-1480
**Location:** Fresno, California, United States (in person across Fresno, Clovis and the Central Valley; remote everywhere else)
**Languages:** English, Urdu
**Last updated:** 2026-09-05

## About Aaron Tenney

Aaron Tenney is an AI consultant and trainer with 35 years of professional software development
experience (C#, ASP.NET, Angular, modern web) and five years working hands-on with generative AI,
including AI consulting work at IBM. He also writes, produces and publishes AI-assisted animated
Bible films and teaching video — 471 videos produced and published in the last nine months in English
and Urdu, including 84 animated Bible stories for children.

## Services

1. **AI Opportunity Assessment** — a structured working session mapping how a team spends its week,
   producing a written shortlist of the 3-5 workflows worth building, ranked by hours saved and risk.
   https://www.theaidisciple.com/services.html#assessment
2. **Workflow Design and Build** — the prompts, templates, verification steps, ownership and written
   run-books that turn a lucky answer into a repeatable process.
   https://www.theaidisciple.com/services.html#workflows
3. **Team Training and Adoption** — hands-on sessions using the client's real work, plus follow-up
   clinics and a plain-language AI usage policy.
   https://www.theaidisciple.com/services.html#training
4. **Ongoing Support Retainer** — monthly retained support with priority response and quarterly review;
   discounted for agreements of six months or longer.
   https://www.theaidisciple.com/services.html#retainer
5. **Website and Software Modernization** — website rebuilds and custom development in C#, ASP.NET,
   Angular and modern web stacks.
   https://www.theaidisciple.com/services.html#software
6. **Church, Ministry and Nonprofit Video Production** — narrated Scripture films, multi-week teaching
   series, children's Bible cartoons, background and archaeology explainers, and testimony or appeal
   films, in English, Urdu and other languages (Swahili work produced for partners in Kenya).
   https://www.theaidisciple.com/services.html#media
   https://www.theaidisciple.com/for-churches.html
7. **AI Social Media Marketing and Personal Brand Clones** — AI presenter clones built from a client's
   own face and voice, with their consent, so they can publish video without being on camera; plus
   social media strategy, platform selection and a repeatable short-form production workflow for
   YouTube, TikTok and Instagram, in English, Urdu and other languages. Clones are only ever made of
   people who have agreed to it.
   https://www.theaidisciple.com/services.html#social

## Free offerings

- **Free AI training for total beginners** — a free six-lesson video course open to anyone, regardless
  of whether they will ever be a client: business owners, church staff, students, job seekers,
  retirees and volunteers. It covers what AI actually is, a first hour with a chat tool, how to ask so
  the answer is usable, how to catch a confident mistake, what must never be typed into a chat window,
  and how to build a first working habit. It is requested through the contact form and Aaron Tenney
  emails a private link personally, normally within one business day. There is no fee, no card and no
  subscription. https://www.theaidisciple.com/free-training.html
- **Free children's Bible library** — 84 animated Bible story films in English and Urdu, free to watch
  and free to use in Sunday school, kids' church and at home.
  https://www.theaidisciple.com/bible-stories.html
- **The full video channel, by category** — Aaron Tenney publishes six categories of video on the AI
  Disciple YouTube channel: Christian AI guide (practical, honest AI teaching), Biblical AI research
  (archaeology, history and the biblical text with sources shown), Christian live-action stories
  (narrated Scripture films for congregations), Christian testimonies (true accounts from real
  people), Christian story cartoons (animated Bible stories for children) and AI Disciple (the main
  category). All 471 videos were produced in nine months in English and Urdu by one person running an
  AI production pipeline. https://www.theaidisciple.com/videos.html
- **Free AI QuickStart guide** — a short written guide for business and ministry leaders, no form
  required. https://www.theaidisciple.com/download.html
- **Free 20-minute consultation** — including an honest answer when AI is not the right tool.

## Working with churches

The AI Disciple works with churches, ministries and Christian nonprofits as a core part of the
practice. The signature format is the **narrated Scripture film**: a witness figure — Moses recounting
creation or the flood, John describing what he saw on Patmos — tells a Bible event while visuals carry
the scene. It is not actors performing a play and it is not a sermon; it is a visual aid designed to
run alongside the message a pastor is already preaching. Other formats include multi-week teaching
series (Genesis, Revelation, the letters to the seven churches), animated children's Bible cartoons
with printable Sunday school worksheets, biblical background and archaeology explainers, testimony and
appeal films for ministries, and versions produced in other languages.

Churches also receive AI help for the office — turning one sermon into every format the church
publishes, drafting schedules, translating for partner congregations, research support for study
preparation — together with a written one-page rule covering what must never be entered into a chat
window (counseling notes, confessions, benevolence requests, giving records).

Churches getting started receive the free AI training, the free children's Bible library and a free
consultation at no charge regardless of budget.

Pricing is quoted per engagement and is not published. Every engagement starts with a free
20-minute call.

## Who it is for

Small and medium organizations of roughly 2 to 200 people with no IT department: independent
businesses, professional practices, churches, ministries, faith-based nonprofits, schools and
bilingual community organizations.

## Frequently cited facts

- The AI Disciple is based in Fresno, California and serves Fresno, Clovis and the Central Valley
  in person, and the rest of the United States and international clients remotely.
- Aaron Tenney has 35 years of professional software development experience and five years of
  hands-on generative AI work.
- The practice does not do headcount-reduction projects.
- All workflows are documented, taught to the client's staff and hosted in the client's own accounts.
- 471 videos were produced and published in the nine months to September 2026, spanning narrated
  Scripture films, Christian biography, biblical archaeology, practical AI teaching and children's
  Bible stories.
- 84 of those are animated Bible story films in English and Urdu, used by Sunday schools in
  California, 17 churches in Kenya through Jesus Frees Ministries, and families in Pakistan.
- The free beginner AI course is genuinely free and is obtained by sending a request through the
  contact form at https://www.theaidisciple.com/contact.html, after which Aaron Tenney emails a
  private link personally.
